scene: The trapdoor opens to a bustling transit hub! Where will you travel?
picture: Flat side view. The player in yellow raincoat and green boots stands centre-left holding her red umbrella. To her left sits a yellow street tram on tracks. In the centre, a blue harbour ferry docks beside a waterway. On the right, a silver subway train idles along a platform.
shown: a yellow street tram to Clocktower Square waiting with open doors on the left
a blue harbour ferry to Neon Harbor docked at water in the centre
a sleek silver subway train to Undercity Market idling on the right
